FORMAT/CVMappingFile.h: a hand-written XML reader, not the standard library: both public members are covered, the constructor as Default and load(filename, mappings, strip_namespaces) as load/load_into with ReadOptions::strip_namespaces (plus read/read_into over BufRead); the XMLFile base is default-constructed in CVMappingFile.cpp, so its isValid throws NotImplemented and getVersion is empty, and nothing inherited is owed.
FORMAT/ControlledVocabulary.h: a hand-written OBO loader and graph, not the standard library: every public member is covered, FNV1aHasher as fnv1a_hash, CVTerm with its eleven fields as CVTermDefinition (XRefType and getXRefTypeName as XRefType/name, isHigherBetterScore, both toXMLString overloads as to_xml/to_xml_value, copy as checked_clone), the constructor, name, label, version, url, loadFromOBO as load_obo, exists, hasTermWithName, getTerm, getTermByName, getTerms as terms, getAllChildTerms and addAllChildTerms, iterateAllChildren, checkAndGetTermByName as find_term_by_name, isChildOf, getPSIMSCV as psi_ms, operator<< as to_text/write_text.
FORMAT/FASTAFile.h: a hand-written reader and writer, not the standard library: every public member is covered, FASTAEntry with its three fields, constructors, ==, headerMatches and sequenceMatches; the constructor; readStart, readStartWithProgress, readNext, readNextWithProgress, position, atEnd, setPosition, writeStart, writeNext, writeEnd, load and store; the ProgressLogger base is the progress field.
FORMAT/HANDLERS/ImzMLHandler.h: a hand-written index parser and .ibd decoder, not the standard library: the constructor and openIBD are ImzMLHandler::open/open_with_ibd, the const getImzMLMeta and getIndex are meta/index, and the SAX onStartElement/onEndElement are replaced by the one-pass read_index. Gaps: the non-const getImzMLMeta has no counterpart, connectDecodeConsumer has no handler-level counterpart (ImzMLFile::load_into_consumer covers only its decode_ibd=true, no-append case), and the public MzMLHandler surface the class inherits is unavailable.
FORMAT/HANDLERS/IndexedMzMLDecoder.h: a hand-written footer scanner, not the standard library: both public members are covered, OffsetVector, parseOffsets as parse_offsets (returning IndexOffsets) and findIndexListOffset with its buffer size as find_index_list_offset/find_index_list_offset_with_buffer_size.
FORMAT/HANDLERS/IndexedMzMLHandler.h: a hand-written random-access reader, not the standard library: the filename constructor and openFile are open/open_with_limits, getNrSpectra/getNrChromatograms are spectrum_count/chromatogram_count, the four getMS*ById/ByNativeId pairs are spectrum/chromatogram/spectrum_by_native_id/chromatogram_by_native_id, and setSkipXMLChecks is options_mut().skip_xml_checks. Gaps: the default and copy constructors, getParsingSuccess, and the two Interfaces::SpectrumPtr/ChromatogramPtr overloads getSpectrumById/getChromatogramById.
FORMAT/HANDLERS/MzMLSqliteSwathHandler.h: a port over the rusqlite crate, so a crate, not the standard library, discharges it: all four public members are covered, the constructor as new/with_limits and readSwathWindows, readMS1Spectra and readSpectraForWindow as read_swath_windows/read_ms1_spectra/read_spectra_for_window; readSwathWindows fills only center/lower/upper of each SwathMap in MzMLSqliteSwathHandler.cpp:44-47, which SwathWindow carries.
FORMAT/MSNUMPRESS/MSNumpress.h: a hand-written codec, not the standard library: all eleven public functions are covered (their pointer and vector overloads as one owned-buffer function each), optimalLinearFixedPoint, optimalLinearFixedPointMass, optimalSlofFixedPoint, encode/decodeLinear, encode/decodeSafe, encode/decodePic and encode/decodeSlof, plus *_with_limits variants.
FORMAT/MSNumpressCoder.h: a port over the base64 and flate2 crates, so crates, not the standard library, discharge it: every public member is covered, BinaryDataEncoder_default_numpressErrorTolerance as DEFAULT_NUMPRESS_ERROR_TOLERANCE, NumpressCompression and NamesOfNumpressCompression as NumpressCompression/ALL/name, NumpressConfig with its five fields and setCompression, the constructor, both encodeNP overloads as encode/encode_f32, decodeNP, encodeNPRaw and decodeNPRaw as encode_raw/decode_raw.
FORMAT/MSstatsFile.h: a hand-written exporter, not the standard library: both public members, storeLFQ and storeISO, are store_lfq/store_iso (with write_lfq/write_iso and the prepare_* row builders), options carried in LfqOptions/IsoOptions.
FORMAT/MzTabBase.h: a hand-written cell vocabulary, not the standard library: every public member of the ten cell classes (MzTabDouble, MzTabDoubleList, MzTabInteger, MzTabIntegerList, MzTabBoolean, MzTabString, MzTabParameter, MzTabParameterList, MzTabStringList, MzTabSpectraRef, including isNull/setNull, isNaN/setNaN, isInf/setInf, get/set, toCellString, fromCellString and the comparison operators), the five metadata structs and MzTabBase's constructor is covered in src/format/mztab.rs.
FORMAT/MzTabMFile.h: a hand-written exporter, not the standard library: both public members, the constructor and store, are covered, and so are the seven protected metadata/header/row generators.
FORMAT/OPTIONS/FeatureFileOptions.h: a hand-written options record, not the standard library: every public member is covered, the constructor as Default, the load-convex-hull, load-subordinates, metadata-only and size-only get/set pairs as public fields, and the RT, m/z and intensity set/has/get triples as Option<Range<f64>> fields (has as is_some).
FORMAT/OPTIONS/PeakFileOptions.h: a hand-written options record, not the standard library: every public member is covered, the constructors and assignment as Default/Clone, the fifteen boolean and size get/set pairs (metadata-only, MQ/TPP compatibility, supplemental data, compression, always-append, fill-data, skip-XML-checks, both sort flags, both 32-bit flags, write-index, max data pool, precursor selected ion, skip-chromatograms) as public fields, the four set/has/get range triples, setMSLevels/addMSLevel/clearMSLevels/hasMSLevels/containsMSLevel/getMSLevels, the three Numpress configuration get/set pairs, and hasFilters.
FORMAT/PercolatorInfile.h: a hand-written PIN reader and writer, not the standard library: every public member is covered, PinFeatureMetaValueMap as StampReport::added_meta_values, store, load, getScanIdentifier as scan_identifier, getStandardFeatureSet as standard_feature_set, and both stampPinFeaturesOnHits overloads as stamp_pin_features (the StampReport returns the skipped set and the added meta values together).
FORMAT/SVOutStream.h: a hand-written writer, not the standard library: every public member is covered, both constructors as new/with_options/create, the operator<< family as write_field/write_char/write_number/write_display/newline, write as write_raw, modifyStrings as set_modify_strings, writeValueOrNan as write_value_or_nan.
FORMAT/SqliteConnector.h: a port over the rusqlite crate, so a crate, not the standard library, discharges it: every public member is covered, SqlOpenMode, the filename constructor with its mode as new/open, tableExists, countTableRows, columnExists, executeStatement and executeBindStatement.
FORMAT/VALIDATORS/MzMLValidator.h: a hand-written validator, not the standard library: its one public member, the (mapping, cv) constructor, is MzMLValidator::new, and its three protected overrides (onStartElement, getPath_, handleTerm_) are its private specialisation; validate and the setters come through the shared ValidationOptions as in SemanticValidator.
FORMAT/VALIDATORS/SemanticValidator.h: a hand-written validator, not the standard library: every public member is covered, the (mapping, cv) constructor, CVTerm as ParsedCVTerm, validate (errors and warnings as ValidationReport), locateTerm as locate_term, and setTag, setAccessionAttribute, setNameAttribute, setValueAttribute, setCheckTermValueTypes, setCheckUnits, setUnitAccessionAttribute and setUnitNameAttribute as ValidationOptions fields. The protected virtual hooks (getPath_, getCVTerm_, handleTerm_) are private functions, not an extension trait, so a new derived validator is written inside the crate.
